tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Town blue, the working brand color. Fills: accordion headers, quick-link hover, the featured-card arrow disc, A–Z letters, the selected inner-page tab. Rules: the 3px footer rule, the back-to-top border, pagination underlines. As text it reads 6.4:1 on `surface`, 5.9:1 on `surface-muted`, 6.1:1 on `surface-footer`; `on-fill` text on it is 6.4:1.

tokens.name: blue-bright
tokens.usage: Service tiles, the Search button and the page band behind content panels. `on-fill` text on it is 4.9:1, so keep labels at 16px or larger. Next to `blue` it is only 1.3:1: never use the two to tell things apart.

tokens.name: blue-hover
tokens.usage: Link color on hover and focus, when the underline drops (5.2:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: Border of the selected inner-page tab.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Heavy rules: the 10px left rule of emphasis box 1, the 7px bottom rule of emphasis box 2, the hover underline of A–Z letters, pagination underlines. `on-fill` text on it is 12.9:1.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Accordion header on hover and focus, and the severity-20 alert banner. Text on it is `ink-on-sky` (4.7:1). The Town site sets white on this fill in its alert banner, which is only 3.7:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The call to action: every button, document link and View all button, the tab hover, and the severity-10 alert banner. Text on it is always `charcoal` (6.3:1), never white.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Only the submit button of the address finder (See what’s around me), with `charcoal` text (6.1:1).

tokens.name: umber
tokens.usage: Unselected homepage tabs, with `on-fill` text (6.6:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, paragraphs and breadcrumbs: a near-black with a green cast. 15.6:1 on `surface`, 14.4:1 on `surface-muted`, 12.7:1 on `surface-band`, 10.7:1 on `alert-low`.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Headings h1–h6, links, top navigation, card titles, footer text, and every label on `gold` or `amber`. 11.2:1 on `surface`, 10.3:1 on `surface-muted`, 10.6:1 on `surface-footer`, 9.1:1 on `surface-band`, 6.3:1 on `gold`.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Search-field text and placeholder, quick links, side-box text and the Required tag. 10.3:1 on `surface`, 9.6:1 on `surface-muted`, 6.2:1 on `required`.

tokens.name: ink-table
tokens.usage: Table header and cell text: 5.1:1 on `surface-table-head`, 5.5:1 on `surface-table`.

tokens.name: ink-on-sky
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `sky` (4.7:1), as in the accordion’s hover and focus state.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: A–Z letters with no entries, on `surface-muted` (1.6:1). Disabled controls only; never for text a resident must read.

tokens.name: visited
tokens.usage: Visited links (5.2:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `blue`, `blue-bright`, `umber`, `navy`, `error`, `success`, `canceled` and `alert-neutral`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Content panels, cards, the selected homepage tab, form fields and the search field.

tokens.name: surface-header
tokens.usage: The 85% translucent band behind the logo and top navigation, laid over the hero photograph (80px tall at desktop width).

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Side boxes (Contact Us), quick links, accordion bodies, emphasis box 2, and the hover fill of A–Z letters.

tokens.name: surface-band
tokens.usage: The full-width grey band behind featured cards, and the event date block.

tokens.name: surface-footer
tokens.usage: The footer’s first row.

tokens.name: surface-table-head
tokens.usage: Table header cells.

tokens.name: surface-table
tokens.usage: Table body cells.

tokens.name: surface-message
tokens.usage: Comment threads and message boxes on public-input pages.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows of search suggestions and social feeds.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The 1px top border between items in content listings.

tokens.name: line-step
tokens.usage: The 2px vertical line that joins numbered steps.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: The 1px border of text inputs, selects and text areas (an alias of `charcoal`, 11.2:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form error text (4.7:1 on `surface`) and destructive buttons such as Log out, with `on-fill` text (4.7:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status labels, with `on-fill` text (4.8:1).

tokens.name: canceled
tokens.usage: Canceled meetings and events: the tag fill (with `on-fill` text, 5.1:1) and the border and text of the canceled notice (5.1:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: alert-neutral
tokens.usage: The emergency banner when no severity is set, with `on-fill` text (9.4:1).

tokens.name: alert-low
tokens.usage: The severity-30 emergency banner, with `ink` text (10.7:1).

tokens.name: required
tokens.usage: Background of the Required tag beside form labels, with `ink-soft` text (6.2:1).

families.sans: "Source Sans Pro", "Source Sans 3", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Charcoal, on a 1.5 line height. h1–h3 are bold, h4 semibold; h5 and h6 are regular weight in capitals.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles, one per page. Also the white title over photographs (What’s happening near me?).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-sections, side-box titles and the quick-links heading.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Small headings, set in capitals with text-transform.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: The smallest headings, set in capitals.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body text is `ink`. Interface text runs a step larger than body.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The Town of Oro Valley is launching its 2026 fall pavement preservation program.
styles.usage: Paragraphs and lists, with 20px under each paragraph.

styles.name: nav-link
styles.usage: Top navigation. Underlined at rest; 900 weight on hover and for the current section.

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: Friday Night Concerts at Steam Pump Ranch
styles.usage: Titles of news, event and featured cards. Service-tile labels use 18px at 600 on a 25.2px line.

styles.name: date-part
styles.usage: Day, month and year in the event date block.

spacing.note: The Town’s theme spaces in 5px steps, plus 12px and 24px in lists, forms and tables.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap under a side-box heading, Required-tag padding, and the space between stacked document links.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Margin under h3–h6 and form labels; the vertical margin around buttons.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Text-input padding; the vertical padding of quick links.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of buttons, side-box titles and accordion headers.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card padding, horizontal button padding, emphasis-box padding, and the margin under paragraphs, h1 and h2.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Table-cell padding; the horizontal padding of quick links.

tokens.name: space-25
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of side boxes and accordions; the vertical padding of the content panel.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: The gap below service tiles and listing cards.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Space above sub-titles in page content; the gap under footer columns.

tokens.name: space-45
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of homepage tabs.

tokens.name: space-60
tokens.usage: Top padding of the footer.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of the footer.

radius.note: Two working radii: 8px for cards and anything that touches the hero, 4px for buttons.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: The canceled tag and tables.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons, document links and the tops of inner-page tabs.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, service tiles, the View all button, the event date block, the outer corners of the search and address fields, and the tops of homepage tabs (8px 8px 0 0).

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Step numbers. The featured-card disc uses a fixed 25px instead, so it stays a pill when it widens on hover.

shadow.note: Soft and warm, and only on things you can click.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Service tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: News, event and public-notice cards.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Top-navigation dropdown menus.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px white gap, then 2px of solid `blue` (6.4:1 on white). Added by this system; the Town site relies on the browser’s 1px dotted outline.

borderWidth.note: Heavy rules carry the Town’s emphasis.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Text inputs, inner-page tabs and their panel, the canceled notice, the step circles.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: The back-to-top button, the white gaps between table cells, and the step line.

tokens.name: border-footer
tokens.usage: The `blue` rule above the footer’s bottom row.

tokens.name: border-letter
tokens.usage: The underline of A–Z letters, and of pagination links on hover.

tokens.name: border-emphasis-bottom
tokens.usage: The `navy` rule under emphasis box 2.

tokens.name: border-emphasis-left
tokens.usage: The `navy` rule left of emphasis box 1.
